stem.en: At ₹150 per kg, Srivalli buys 1 kg, Alex buys 2 kg and Israt buys 3 kg. A fourth buyer comes to the same market and buys 4 kg at that price. What is the market demand at ₹150 per kg now?

text.en: 6 kg, the same as in the table, because the price has not changed.
2.5 kg, the average amount that one of the four buyers buys.
4 kg, because the newest buyer buys the most.
10 kg, because we add what all four buyers buy at that price.

explanation.en: Market demand adds what every buyer wants at the same price: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10 kg. A new buyer adds to the total even though the price stays the same. An average describes one typical buyer, not the whole market.

hints.en: Stay at one price, and add what every buyer buys there.
